anchors.label: ASSETTYPE
anchors.regex: (?:^|\|\s*)(?:Asset-Backed Securities|Common Stocks|LLC Interests|Preferred Stocks|Senior Secured Loans|Warrants)(?:\s*\||$)

notes: Bundle identifiers are pipe-delimited and carry asset type, industry, issuer/instrument/tranche, and sometimes reference rate, spread, coupon text, stated percent rate, PIK text, and maturity date.
Warrants appears in bundle none_examples as an asset-type token; source evidence CLI confirmation could not run in this sandbox because pandas is unavailable.
